name: komdosh-dev-tasker
description: Pull one Jira ticket from a project's Todo column via the Atlassian MCP, transition it forward to In Progress, hand the ticket description to the lifecycle-supervisor as the captured requirement, then transition it to In Review when all gates pass (or ask the user otherwise). /jira-task [PROJ|PROJ-123]. Forward-only column walk — never hardcodes status names. Refuses to run if the Atlassian MCP is not detected. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core + komdosh-dev-spring-orchestrator.
